excludes_star_note: excludes star means the 95% intervals do not overlap.
pooled_wilson_note: The pooled Wilson interval treats messages as independent.
retry_note: star sends each message by unicast with ACK and up to 5 retries; in the relay topology the drone's first leg is a single broadcast with no ACK or retry, and only the relay-to-gs leg retries, so relay_gain partly reflects that retry difference.
